measures.name: paid_order_count_measure

measures.name: cancelled_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: partial_refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: full_refund_order_count_measure

measures.name: payment_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: refund_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: net_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: gross_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: discount_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: refund_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: selling_store_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN store_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: valid_order_items_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN quantity ELSE 0 END

measures.name: new_member_count_measure
measures.expr: member_id

measures.name: first_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: first_order_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: first_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: repeat_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: monthly_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 AND valid_order_count >= 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: monthly_paid_order_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 THEN valid_order_count ELSE 0 END

measures.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 AND valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计的全部创建订单数，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后续退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额大于累计退款金额的订单数。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零且小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零且退款金额等于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 状态订单实付金额合计，未扣除退款（分）。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 状态订单累计退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属（分）。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 状态订单实付扣减退款后的净销售金额合计（分）。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 状态订单原价金额合计（分）。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 状态订单原价减实付的优惠金额合计（分）。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计期内至少有一笔有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计期内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 统计期内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买商品件数合计。

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.label: 有效订单均额
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数（分/单）。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数（分/账户）。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.label: 购买频次
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数（单/账户）。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.label: 退款金额占比
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额。

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: 取消率
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.label: 退款订单率
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数。

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.label: 优惠率
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额。

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: 单均商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数（件/单）。

metrics.name: new_member_count
metrics.label: 注册会员数
metrics.description: 按注册日期统计的新注册 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: first_buyer_count
metrics.label: 观测期首购会员数
metrics.description: 测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents
metrics.label: 观测期首单净销售额
metrics.description: 账户测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额合计（分）。

metrics.name: first_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期首单数
metrics.description: 账户测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数合计。

metrics.name: repeat_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期后续购买订单数
metrics.description: 账户测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单落入窗口的单数合计。

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内购买会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月内有至少一笔有效订单的会员账户数。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内复购会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月内有至少两笔有效订单的会员账户数。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月内复购率
metrics.description: 同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员购买人数
metrics.description: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单且月末符合付费资格（本期暂定口径）的不同会员账户数。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_order_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员有效订单数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格（本期暂定口径）的账户在当月的全部有效订单数。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents
metrics.label: 月末付费会员净销售额
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格（本期暂定口径）的账户在当月的有效订单净销售额合计（分）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购人数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格（本期暂定口径）且当月至少两笔有效订单的不同会员账户数。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购率
metrics.description: 月末付费会员复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数（本期暂定口径）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_avg_order_value
metrics.label: 月末付费会员订单均额
metrics.description: 月末付费会员净销售额除以有效订单数（本期暂定口径，分/单）。

model_sql.ranked_orders:
SELECT
    order_id,
    member_id,
    store_id,
    ordered_at,
    paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at ASC, order_id ASC) AS order_seq
FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents
model_sql.member_monthly_summary:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at)::DATE AS month_start,
        (DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS month_end,
        member_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count,
        SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_sales_cents,
        BOOL_OR(ordered_at < (DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE) AS has_prior_purchase
    FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
    WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
qualified_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mo.month_start,
        mo.member_id
    FROM monthly_orders mo
    JOIN {{ ref('cards') }} c ON mo.member_id = c.member_id
    WHERE c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡')
      AND c.valid_until > mo.month_end
      AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR c.ended_at > mo.month_end)
      AND (
          c.valid_from < mo.month_end
          OR (c.valid_from = mo.month_end AND mo.has_prior_purchase)
      )
)
SELECT
    mo.member_id || '_' || CAST(mo.month_start AS VARCHAR) AS member_month_id,
    mo.member_id,
    mo.month_start,
    mo.valid_order_count,
    mo.net_sales_cents,
    CASE WHEN qm.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_paid_member
FROM monthly_orders mo
LEFT JOIN qualified_members qm
  ON mo.month_start = qm.month_start
 AND mo.member_id = qm.member_id

business_model_usage.quote: 账户与订单、账户与卡分别是一对多关系。
订单指标必须分清线上与门店渠道，不能混在一起看；
小程序订单上的门店编号在 IT 核实前不能当作门店归属；
本期统计不改变现有门店考核，也不代表门店执行已经改善；
并在回答中注明“按账户当前等级，不是注册当时的等级”
门店现场到期/终止当天已失效
须等老周核对完系统记录再与门店做法对齐
若门店实际做法与运营月报口径存在差异
